release_notes:
1. Streamlined Back Office configuration: Removed redundant GA4 Measurement ID and sGTM Preview Header fields in favor of direct PrestaShop Webhook Client routing.
2. All server webhooks dispatch pure, authoritative JSON carrying event_name, financial totals, items, and SHA-256 customer data.
3. Direct native compatibility with prestashop-client-template.tpl and Stape Data Client.
